submitted.rationale: Mg-Sb-O is made of wide-gap phases: MgO, MgSb2O6 trirutile and Mg4Sb2O9. None of these should absorb 2.4 eV photons, so EQE was expected to be close to zero across the whole line, and the measurements confirmed this. The highest value was at the Sb-rich end, index 29 (Sb 0.807): 0.00096%, about 5x the next-highest value (index 25, 0.0002%). This fits with Sb-oxide phases such as Sb2O4 or Sb6O13, which may absorb weakly at this photon energy, becoming more common as Sb increases.
